001import javafx.application.Application;
002import javafx.stage.Stage;
003import javafx.scene.Scene;
004import javafx.scene.layout.BorderPane;
005import javafx.scene.layout.HBox;
006import javafx.geometry.Insets;
007import javafx.geometry.Pos;
008import javafx.scene.control.ListView;
009import javafx.scene.control.Label;
010import javafx.scene.control.Button;
011import javafx.scene.control.RadioButton;
012import javafx.scene.control.ToggleGroup;
013import javafx.collections.FXCollections;
014import javafx.collections.ObservableList;
015
016/**
017 * Goal 5 - JavaFX GUI for the Jukebox project.
018 * Sets up the main window and starts wiring in
019 * the classes from the earlier goals.
020 *
021 * @author Joel Cipher
022 * @version 1.0
023 */
024public class testGoal5 extends Application {
025
026    // main project classes that this GUI will talk to
027    private SongList songList;
028    private balanceBox balance;
029    private purchaseQueue queue;
030
031    // label at the bottom to show which song is playing
032    private Label nowPlayingLabel;
033
034    @Override
035    public void start(Stage primaryStage) {
036
037        // basic setup of the core classes
038        songList = new SongList("songs.txt");
039        balance = new balanceBox();
040        queue = new purchaseQueue(songList, balance);
041
042        // main layout
043        BorderPane root = new BorderPane();
044        root.setPadding(new Insets(10));
045
046        // top: sort radio buttons
047        HBox topBar = new HBox(10);
048        topBar.setPadding(new Insets(5));
049        topBar.setAlignment(Pos.CENTER_LEFT);
050
051        ToggleGroup sortGroup = new ToggleGroup();
052
053        // sort options (no real sorting yet, just the UI for Goal 5)
054        RadioButton sortByTitle = new RadioButton("Title");
055        sortByTitle.setToggleGroup(sortGroup);
056        sortByTitle.setSelected(true); // default
057
058        RadioButton sortByArtist = new RadioButton("Artist");
059        sortByArtist.setToggleGroup(sortGroup);
060
061        RadioButton sortByTime = new RadioButton("Time");
062        sortByTime.setToggleGroup(sortGroup);
063
064        topBar.getChildren().addAll(sortByTitle, sortByArtist, sortByTime);
065        root.setTop(topBar);
066
067        // center: list of songs
068        ObservableList<String> songItems = FXCollections.observableArrayList();
069
070        // get the raw String[][] from SongList
071        String[][] songs = songList.getSongArray();
072
073        // assuming each song row has [0]=title, [1]=artist, [2]=cost
074        for (int i = 0; i < songs.length; i++) {
075            if (songs[i] != null && songs[i][0] != null) {
076                String title = songs[i][0];
077                String artist = songs[i][1];
078                String entry = title + " - " + artist;
079                songItems.add(entry);
080            }
081        }
082
083        ListView<String> songListView = new ListView<>(songItems);
084        root.setCenter(songListView);
085
086        // bottom: now playing + buttons
087        HBox bottomBar = new HBox(20);
088        bottomBar.setPadding(new Insets(5));
089        bottomBar.setAlignment(Pos.CENTER_LEFT);
090
091        nowPlayingLabel = new Label("Now Playing: (none)");
092
093        Button enqueueButton = new Button("Enqueue");
094        Button enqueueFrontButton = new Button("Enqueue Front");
095        Button addCoinButton = new Button("Add Coin");
096        Button addCreditButton = new Button("Add Credit");
097
098        // basic button behavior for now (Goal 5 level)
099        // when user clicks Enqueue, try to add the selected song to the queue
100        enqueueButton.setOnAction(e -> {
101            int selectedIndex = songListView.getSelectionModel().getSelectedIndex();
102            if (selectedIndex >= 0) {
103                boolean ok = queue.addSong(selectedIndex, false);
104                System.out.println("Enqueue clicked for index: " + selectedIndex + ", success=" + ok);
105                System.out.println(queue.displayQueue());
106                // for Goal 5: just update the label to show whichever song was last selected
107                String selectedText = songListView.getSelectionModel().getSelectedItem();
108                nowPlayingLabel.setText("Now Playing: " + selectedText);
109            } else {
110                System.out.println("No song selected to enqueue.");
111            }
112        });
113
114        enqueueFrontButton.setOnAction(e -> {
115            System.out.println("Enqueue Front clicked (not implemented yet).");
116            // Goal 5 does not require this to actually change the queue
117        });
118
119        addCreditButton.setOnAction(e -> {
120            System.out.println("Add Credit clicked (not implemented yet).");
121            // Same as above: real logic is in Goal 6
122        });
123
124        bottomBar.getChildren().addAll(
125                nowPlayingLabel,
126                enqueueButton,
127                enqueueFrontButton,
128                addCoinButton,
129                addCreditButton
130        );
131
132        root.setBottom(bottomBar);
133
134        // scene and window setup
135        Scene scene = new Scene(root, 800, 600);
136        primaryStage.setTitle("Jukebox");
137        primaryStage.setScene(scene);
138        primaryStage.show();
139    }
140
141    /**
142     * Launches the JavaFX application.
143     * @param args command line arguments
144     */
145    public static void main(String[] args) {
146        launch(args);
147    }
148}
